This explicitly changes reference analysis precision from its initial F32 implementation.

sequential_reduction_diagnosis.method: Actual paired-model PyTorch logits; simulate scalar sequential F32 vocabulary reductions using numpy.cumsum(dtype=float32). No Rust/model source modification.

pairwise_reduction_diagnosis.method: Independent reference; pairwise adjacent F32 sums with one zero appended when width is odd, repeated to width1. No source or primary oracle modifications.

reproducible_diagnostic.method: Same actual F32 final and embedding-lens logits; only analysis arithmetic differs. NumPy simulates reduction order, not backend-specific exponential approximations.
